result.summary: The diff is a single-file README.md edit that faithfully implements ISSUE-1's ticket body verbatim, replacing the old "interactive blog / digital clone" pitch with the new "minimalist portfolio for builders" positioning and the Author/Posts/Products concept list; the implementer even cleaned up grammar and typos present in the ticket text (its/it's, "direct messagings"→"direct messaging", "just wants to write their process"→"just want to write about their process") and correctly converted the ticket's escaped "1\\)" list markers into proper Markdown ordered-list syntax. No correctness, security, or convention issues found — markdown structure and heading hierarchy match the rest of the file, and the "Products" label matches the ticket's explicit wording rather than being an accidental drift from the codebase's internal "projects" feature name. The harness-reported lint and typecheck failures are pre-existing environment issues (missing eslint binary / no root "typecheck" script) unrelated to this README-only change, not defects introduced by the diff.
